title: Fresh Slots Picks
author: Buzz Tum
contentHtml:
Are you looking for some new slots to try? Maybe a brand-new version of one of your old favourites? Well, here’s what you need! In this article, we’ll take a look at a few games that you might find on YesPlay.

Setting Your Stake

Starting to play the game is easy. Simply adjust "Level" to set the number of coins per line, and use "Coin Value" to change how much they are worth; this will allow you to control your total bet. You can spin from R0.10 up to R100. If you’re feeling risky you can always click on “Max Bet”, if not, you can sit back and relax by clicking on “Autoplay”, or you can hit that “Spin” button and hope for the best.

What’s Extra Special

And now, time for all the cool stuff that everyone is going to be interested in: The Wild symbol (Pegasus, the winged horse) is a special symbol that can appear at any time and if you land one, you’ll be awarded a free re-spin. This keeps on happening until all Wilds are gone. But that’s not all, if you happen to land another Wild symbol behind a falling one, you’ll activate the “Wild on Wild” feature, which will expand the Wild to cover the entire reel, leading to massive payouts. But that’s not all, if you manage to get four or more Scatter symbols (the hand holding lightning), you’ll be handsomely rewarded with 10, 15, or 20 free spins! During these free spins, any Wild you land will expand to cover the whole reel. You can also collect Bronze, Silver, or Gold coins. And if you collect five of the same kind, you will win 10x your bet for Bronze, 25x for Silver, or 500x for Gold!

Want to give this fun slot a try? Then check out https://yesplay.bet/slots/divine-fortune-megaways.

The Banana Bonus

Here’s where this game gets really interesting. Banana symbols appearing on reels 3, 4, and 5 each have cash values (ranging from 1x to 25x your bet) or even Mini, Major, or Mega jackpot values (worth 50x, 100x, or 500x your bet). In order to get these amounts, you need to have Wild symbols appear on reels 1 and 2, right next to those bananas. The free spins are awarded whenever Wilds appear on the first two reels along with a Bonus symbol on the third reel. Free spins can trigger a "Golden Money" symbol on reels 3, 4, or 5 which stretches its reel, up to 8 symbols high! If a Golden Money symbol happens to land on a reel that is already 8 cells high, you’ll get an extra 5 to 10 free spins. If you’re intrigued, then check out https://yesplay.bet/slots/wild-wild-bananas.
